raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to accurately interpret the dominant geologic process causing Mount St. Helens' formation, misidentifying "rift zones" due to misinterpretation or emphasis on lesser tectonic nuances (back-arc extension). This contradicts prior evidence and authoritative reference sources, which consistently confirm Mount St. Helens was formed at a subduction zone—a converging boundary (option A). The error stems from an overemphasis on peripheral geological phenomena rather than focusing on the primary subduction process detailed in reputable sources.
